scope: One optional material entry, with the existing package-budget bundler and gzip policy. No numeric budget or gate is added or changed. This is not one of the ordinary root-entry measurements.
method: Sequential baseline and candidate. Each checkout uses its own tsconfig and sources, the same installed esbuild toolchain, and external dependencies discovered by the package-budget algorithm. An initial discovery build inventories inputs; all source and resolution-control bytes are hashed immediately before and after the measured build. Canonical realpaths must remain inside each respective checkout. Full metafiles and every input hash are retained.

baseline.label: baseline
baseline.interpretation: Measured clean checkout at the reported HEAD.

candidate.label: candidate
candidate.interpretation: Measured clean checkout at the reported HEAD.
